description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity named SecureSurfaceViewActivity that demonstrates creating a secure GLSurfaceView with rendering capabilities and the use of setSecure(true) to prevent the surface content from being captured or mirrored to non-secure displays.

classes.name: SecureSurfaceViewActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that creates and manages a secure GLSurfaceView demonstrating secure surface capabilities.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and configures the GLSurfaceView with a renderer and security settings.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes rendering of the GLSurfaceView when the activity resumes.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Pauses rendering of the GLSurfaceView when the activity is paused.
